text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping one day, I spot<n>Nishino
Flower standing in a store's nail<n>product section.
She looks lost.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
This is all nail polish? There's so many. I<n>don't
even know where to start...

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... How 'bout the one up there? It<n>dries quick
and doesn't chip easy.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: Jordan?! U-um, this isn't what it looks<n>like!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Huh? So... you're not buying nail stuff?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Who, me? Th-that'd just look weird. I-I<n>mean, it's
not like doing my nails like an<n>adult will actually
make me one, right?

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, no shame in owning up. Which<n>one do you
want?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: W-well, um...

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
For now, why don'tcha just pick a color<n>you vibe
with? Don't worry about the<n>base coat, I'll lend
you mine.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Um, then... a pink one. I think Bourbon<n>would like
that too...

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you two are gonna match? Hmm...<n>How's one
of these pinks, then?

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there, Jordan! You're<n>biasing her
decision!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
Hear her out first! Do you even know<n>why she's
here?

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Yikes, killjoy alert. C'mon, Flower, let's<n>go.

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
Killjoy?! I'm only giving my sincere<n>advice as a
class repre—

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
All right, all right! If you're so worried,<n>why don't
you tag along then? That goes<n>for you over there
too, snoops!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text: Paint all the way to the edges... but not<n>too far...

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Нишино Флауэр carefully follows Tosen<n>Jordan's
instructions as she paints the<n>nails I offered up for
practice. They turn<n>out a lovely pink.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Yep, looking good. All that's left is to<n>let them
dry.

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea just painting them would<n>be so
difficult. Maybe I'm still not ready<n>for this...

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look. Painting your nails—all<n>fashion,
really—is something you do for<n>yourself, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
It's like when you look in the mirror after<n>doing
your makeup, and you're like,<n>"Wow, you're
killing it, girl." Kinda like<n>our signature racewear
too, actually.

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah! I get super fired up when I put<n>mine on!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Right? So if you wanna give offgrown-up vibes, you gotta look the partso you can feel the part! Here—lean overfor a sec.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Тосэн Джордан pulls out a translucent lip<n>gloss
from her pouch and applies it to<n>Нишино Флауэр's
lips.

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Not much difference<n>
looks-wise, but you feel glowed-up,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Ehehe, you're right. I already feel a<n>little
more mature!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text:
There you go. Told you—look the part<n>and the
rest'll follow.

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
I wholeheartedly agree! As class<n>representative, I
make sure I always look<n>the part!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Huh... Actually, your hair's, like, nevernot perfect. Don't tell me you're thesuper fussy type?

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакусин-О
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha, so you've noticed! I always<n>keep my
hair in order—just like my<n>priorities! As soon as
it's tied up, I'm in<n>full class rep mode!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
So you start with looks too! I remember<n>when
Jordan did my nails during the<n>sweets
competition—I felt like a<n>grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Нишино Флауэр
text_block_list.text:
I'm... I'm going to get better at doing my<n>nails!
Jordan, please teach me<n>everything you know!

text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан
text_block_list.text: Bet. Hit me up whenever, 'kay?
